title: ViMultiChoice: Toward a Method That Gives Explanation for Multiple-Choice Reading Comprehension in Vietnamese
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing a new Vietnamese Multiple-Choice Reading Comprehension (MCRC) dataset (ViRCSoSciD) and a model (ViMultiChoice) specifically designed for the Vietnamese language. While the dataset includes content from the 'Civic Education' subject (which can touch on morals), the paper's primary objective is the technical evaluation of reading comprehension and explanation generation capabilities, rather than a specific benchmark of ethics, religion, or spiritual traditions.
